pages.title: Starlit Village Post Front
pages.concept: A tiny snow-covered village post office sits beneath a vast starlit winter sky, with a glowing berry-red letter box and envelopes transforming into golden stars.
pages.artwork_description: Portrait front cover with the small post office in the lower centre, its amber-lit windows and snow-laden roof nestled among softly receding blue-grey hills. A glowing muted berry-red letter box forms the focal point in front of the building. Three small cream envelopes rise from the letter box and gradually become tiny golden stars across the open cobalt upper sky. Refined serif text in the upper sky reads: “Christmas Wishes”.
pages.generation_prompt: Card front: small snow-covered village post office in the lower centre beneath an expansive cobalt winter sky; glowing muted berry-red letter box in the foreground, warm amber windows, softly layered snowy hills, three cream envelopes lifting upward and changing into tiny golden stars. Keep broad open upper-sky space for refined serif title text exactly: “Christmas Wishes”.
pages.production_notes: Verify title spelling and use a refined serif typeface rather than relying on generated lettering if necessary. Keep the letter box, building and envelopes clear at finished card size. Retain printable midtone sky values despite full-bleed artwork; allow bleed and keep title away from trim edges.

pages.title: Warm Wishes Inside
pages.concept: A quiet interior greeting panel that continues the postal-star motif while leaving generous space for the printed message and a handwritten note.
pages.artwork_description: Mostly soft cream interior panel with a delicate frosted blue-grey pencil-and-gouache border suggestion: tiny scattered stars at the top and a low snowy silhouette of village rooftops along the bottom. In the lower right, a miniature amber-lit red letter box with one small cream envelope adds a subtle echo of the cover. Centred refined serif message reads: “Wishing you a Christmas filled with warmth, peace and hope.” A calm blank area remains beneath for a personal message.
pages.generation_prompt: Card inside panel: soft cream ground with restrained decorative border details, tiny frosted blue-grey stars near the top and a low snowy village-rooftop silhouette along the bottom; miniature muted berry-red letter box with amber glow and one small cream envelope in the lower right. Centred refined serif greeting text exactly: “Wishing you a Christmas filled with warmth, peace and hope.” Leave generous uncluttered blank writing space beneath the greeting.
pages.production_notes: Verify exact UK-English message punctuation and typeset manually if image text is unreliable. Preserve ample blank writing area below the message. Keep all text and the lower-right illustration within fold and trim safety zones; coordinate placement with the chosen folded-card imposition.

pages.title: Starlit Village Post Back
pages.concept: A discreet artistically coordinated back panel featuring a single posted envelope and star, with no branding required.
pages.artwork_description: A calm deep-but-print-safe cobalt and frosted blue-grey winter wash with a small snow drift at the base. Near the lower centre sits one tiny cream envelope bearing a muted berry-red seal, with a single golden star rising above it. No printed wording or logo.
pages.generation_prompt: Card back: restrained print-safe cobalt and frosted blue-grey winter wash with a small snow drift at the base; one tiny cream envelope with a muted berry-red seal near the lower centre, one small golden star floating above it; no wording, no logo.
pages.production_notes: Keep the back panel minimal and lighter than a solid dark ink field for home printing. No text to verify. Include printing and folding guide as a separate non-artwork deliverable covering A4 and US Letter paper, duplex settings, trim marks if supplied, and fold direction.

Full colour in deep cobalt and inky navy, frosted blue-grey, soft cream, muted berry red and warm amber; gentle tonal shading, dry-brush texture, subtle crosshatching and cosy luminous accents. Refined, nostalgic adult Christmas-card mood, with a clear focal hierarchy and generous calm space for elegant serif typography; home-print friendly contrast and restrained ink coverage.
